salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). KernelCraft formal verification of GPU kernels by agents (Level 1: twelve tasks per target language PTX, CUDA, HIP). GPT-6 Luna column of Table 2: pass rate over the twelve tasks per target language (3 measures) with the mean input and output tokens over the proven tasks (millions) attached as usage of the same measure. The per-task pass/fail/budget strings, per-task token counts (Table 11), tokens per stage (Table 12) and the failure analysis (Table 13) are categorical or counts of runs: kept as notes, not measures. Effort xhigh for the backward and proof agents (Table 10 flags --backward-effort xhigh, --proof-effort xhigh; --other-effort default (xhigh)); spending ceiling 50 USD per verification and a round cap of 16 (Tables 7 and 10); no provider named. A failed run spends to its budget, so the token means cover the proven tasks only. | salvo14/mig/s6 (10 Nov 2026), complementary lot k-openai-3 (c2-openai). KernelCraft (arXiv 2611.02028), Table 11: the input and output tokens of the verification of each of the twelve Level 1 tasks (ReLU, SiLU, GELU, Softmax, LayerNorm, RMSNorm, GEMV, GEMM, Linear, BatchMatmul, Conv2D, DepthwiseConv), per model and target language (CUDA, PTX, HIP), for GPT-6 Luna and for the three fit models of the table (GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). Facts of tokens only (never scores): 12 tasks x 2 x 3 languages x 4 models = 288 facts, written in millions in the table and converted to tokens (x 1,000,000, the written value kept). A value in parentheses is the tokens of a run that failed or stopped at its budget (the legend); the per-task outcome (pass / fail / budget) is kept in the note of each fact. The 'Total' column (average over the proven tasks) is already in the repository (Table 2) and is not repeated. These facts are not attached to a measure: the pass/fail per task is categorical and stays out of the measures (the earlier choice); they are listed in notes/attach-02028.json for the integration.
